ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the following schematic diagram of solar altitude changing with longitude and latitude: <image1> Among the four points a, b, c, and d, which point has the smallest difference between day and night length during a year?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the right-hand graph shows the variation of noon solar altitude with latitude, and the vertical axis is marked with solar altitudes of 90° and 60°. The highest point of the curve is 90°, and its position is marked at 15°S, indicating that the Sun is directly overhead at 15°S at this time. In the figure, the 60° horizontal dashed line intersects the curve at points b and c; b is on the north side of the 15°S peak, and c is on the south side; a and d are farther away from the peak position than b and c respectively, and their solar altitudes are lower. Reasoning: according to the noon solar altitude formula H=90°-|φ-δ|, at this time δ=-15°. For point b, H=60°, so |φ+15°|=30°, and b is on the north side of the peak, so φ=15°N; point c is also 60° but is on the south side, so φ=45°S. a and d are farther away from the direct-sun point at 15°S than b and c, and their absolute latitudes will not be smaller than b's. The difference between day and night length during a year increases as absolute latitude increases; the closer to the equator, the smaller the difference. Among the four points, point b has the smallest absolute latitude and is closest to the equator, so it has the smallest difference between day and night length during a year.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the following schematic diagram of solar altitude changing with longitude and latitude:

<image1>

Among the four points a, b, c, and d, which point has the smallest difference between day and night length during a year?

method.method_draft: First describe the right graph: the maximum noon solar altitude is 90° at 南纬15度, and b/c are at H=60° on opposite sides of that peak. Apply H=90°-|φ-(-15°)|. For b, |φ+15°|=30° and since b is on the northward side, φ=15°N; for c, φ=45°S. The other points a and d are farther from the 15°S peak than b/c, hence at still higher absolute latitudes than b on their respective sides. Compare absolute latitudes: b is closest to 0° latitude, so its day-night length difference over a year is smallest. Answer b点.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：右侧图表示正午太阳高度随纬度的变化，纵轴标有太阳高度90°和60°。曲线最高点为90°，位置标在南纬15°，说明此时太阳直射南纬15°。图中60°水平虚线与曲线相交于b、c两点，b位于南纬15°峰值的北侧，c位于南侧；a、d分别比b、c更远离峰值位置，太阳高度更低。推理：根据正午太阳高度公式H=90°-|φ-δ|，此时δ=-15°。b点H=60°，所以|φ+15°|=30°，且b在峰值北侧，因此φ=15°N；c点同为60°但在南侧，因此φ=45°S。a和d比b、c更远离南纬15°直射点，纬度绝对值不会比b更小。一年中昼夜长短差异随纬度绝对值增大而增大，越接近赤道差异越小。四点中b点纬度绝对值最小，最接近赤道，所以一年中昼夜长短相差最小。
